interactives.label: Rules of the bunds
interactives.text: One party at a time. The flood brings them to you; the bunds behind stay quiet once you have cleared them. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The seed store
interactives.text: The delta's seed rice was kept dry here. What the floods could not reach, the crabs did.

interactives.label: The weir-keeper's chest
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
